faqs.q: Is the IDFC Millennia Credit Card good?
faqs.a: Yes, IDFC FIRST Millennia Credit Card is a good option for those looking for a basic credit card with no annual charges. It offers decent rewards along with benefits such as movie discounts and complimentary railway lounge access.

faqs.q: What is the IDFC FIRST Millennia Credit Card eligibility criteria?
faqs.a: The applicant must have an annual income of at least Rs. 3 lakh. Apart from this, your eligibility depends on other internal policies as set by the credit card provider.

faqs.q: Who can get FIRST Digital RuPay Credit Card?
faqs.a: At present, only FIRST Classic, FIRST Millennia, FIRST Wealth, FIRST Select, FIRST Private, FIRST WOW!, and FIRST SWYP credit cardholders can get FIRST Digital RuPay Credit Card.

faqs.q: Does IDFC FIRST Millenia Credit Card provide airport lounge access?
faqs.a: No, IDFC FIRST Millenia Credit Card does not offer airport lounge access. However, it offers 4 complimentary railway lounge visits every quarter.

faqs.q: Is there any annual fee for IDFC Millennia Credit Card?
faqs.a: No, IDFC Millennia Credit Card is a lifetime free card and does not charge any joining or annual fees.

faqs.q: What is the minimum salary for IDFC FIRST Millennia Credit Card?
faqs.a: To apply for IDFC Millennia Credit Card, you must have an annual income of Rs. 3 lakh or more. Besides this, you may also be required to provide necessary documents at the time of application, as per the bank’s policies.

faqs.q: How can I contact IDFC FIRST Bank Credit Card customer care?
faqs.a: You can call the 24X7 helpline number 180010888 to contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care.

faqs.q: Is it possible to upgrade from IDFC FIRST Millennia Credit Card to a higher-tier card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can contact the customer service and ask if you are eligible for a credit card upgrade. Besides this, in case you become eligible for a better card, the bank also sends you an email or message regarding a credit card upgrade.
